info.title: weBump Platform API preview
info.description: Developer preview: reviewed projects, explicit player approval, scoped bearer tokens, game-defined private JSON saves, separately opted-in selected shared JSON, public showcases and eligible visitors. Public client IDs are not secrets: copying configuration can initiate a request but cannot alone access protected player data. Redirect callbacks protect code delivery with PKCE, not the origin of later API requests. Reviewed device grants authorize the device the player confirms; neither method attests an official app binary. CORS is not client authentication. See https://developer.webump.app/tutorial#security-model. Rate-limit budgets and retry guidance: https://developer.webump.app/rate-limits.html.

parameters.name: display
parameters.description: popup: for browser games that open the approval in a popup. The approval page then waits for the phone's decision and delivers the callback to that popup. Omit for native apps opening the system browser; the link may open the weBump app directly.

post.summary: Redeem a callback code, poll device approval, or rotate a refresh token
post.description: Supports authorization_code + S256 PKCE, rotating refresh_token, and urn:ietf:params:oauth:grant-type:device_code with client_id/device_code. Device polling returns authorization_pending, slow_down (add 5 seconds), access_denied, expired_token or scoped tokens once. Never retry uncertain successful redemption.

post.summary: List publicly shared game cards on a profile (first-party app only)
post.description: Requires installation authentication. Returns only explicitly published showcase fields from active projects and player grants. Bilateral blocks, suspension and revocation remove cards. Private saves and capsule data are never returned; an unknown or unavailable profile returns an empty games array.

get.description: Requires game.shared in both the approved project and player grant. Conditional mutations use the same revision as private state, capsule and showcase. Absent or expired publications return data {} and expires_at null.

put.description: Requires game.shared in both the approved project and player grant. Conditional mutations use the same revision as private state, capsule and showcase. Requires separate first-party player opt-in and publish:true. Replaces the single current publication, expiring in seven days. value must match data_definition.shared and fit 16 KiB in both wire JSON and JSONB text. The first publication requires a later eligible bump; updates during an uninterrupted, unexpired publication keep those visitors eligible. Withdrawal or an expiry gap starts a new publication. Private state is never copied automatically.

delete.description: Requires game.shared in both the approved project and player grant. Conditional mutations use the same revision as private state, capsule and showcase. Keeps private state and the sharing preference. Old visitor references cannot retrieve a publication restarted after erasure or expiry. Updates during an uninterrupted, unexpired publication preserve eligibility.

get.summary: Retrieve selected shared data through an authorized visitor reference
get.description: Requires game.shared and visitors.receive. Reference must belong to this player grant, be redeemed, released and unexpired. The source needs a current same-project game.shared grant, explicit sharing and an uninterrupted, unexpired publication, all established before the bump epoch. Updating that document preserves eligibility; restarting after withdrawal or expiry does not. Current privacy, exclusion, block and suspension rules apply. Returns 410 consent_required if unavailable; remove cached copies on withdrawal or expiry. Payload never appears in ordinary visitor responses or app profile cards. Read the shared-data tutorial for the reviewed JSON schema subset and limits.

post.description: Status only for all callers, including legacy POST and peek. Never returns codes, callback URLs, tokens or private device credentials. Does not register a waiting browser.

get.description: Status only for all callers, including legacy POST and peek. Never returns codes, callback URLs, tokens or private device credentials. Does not register a waiting browser.

Requires visitors.receive. Returns the people this player bumped, including verifiable recent history synced by weBump whose bump is unwrapped and reveal delay has passed and who still allow sharing, up to 50, ordered by reference. Listing marks them delivered, which unlocks /v1/me/visitors/{reference}/shared. Refresh when your game gains focus or before a session, with bounded polling and Retry-After backoff within your request budget. The visitor handoff remains available for an explicit, player-chosen transfer.

get.summary: QR code for an approval request
get.description: Supply exactly one request reference (redirect flow) or user_code (device flow). Returns image/svg+xml encoding the public approval link for a live request. Never contains device_code or an authorization code. Expired or unknown requests return 404. Rate limited per reference.

200.description: A self-contained SVG with no script, external references or embedded links.

200.description: Device authorization; no-store. Keep device_code private. Display user_code plus QR/manual verification link.

post.description: Requires device_code in project.connection_methods. No callback or PKCE parameters. Display user_code on the requesting device and require matching confirmation in weBump; device_code stays private. Device authorization does not attest genuine software or enforce callback-origin delivery.

PlayerToken.description: Opaque project/player token. Installation secrets are never accepted.

stats_revision.description: Content revision of the shared stats; private state writes do not change it.

visitor_id.description: Opaque repeat-visitor recognition scoped to project/environment and receiving player. Stable while unexpired receipts maintain continuity; resets after expiry gaps, visitor opt-out/project exclusion, blocks, explicit game disconnect/revocation/deletion. Not a lookup key or permanent/global person ID. Use reference for authorized reads; never group older cards by name/color.

SharedDocument.description: Selected publication, separate from private saves. data is {} and expires_at is null when absent or expired. Shares the player revision with state/capsule/showcase.

Error400.description: Invalid request, OAuth grant or schema.

Error403.description: Insufficient scope, suspension or consent required.

Error410.description: Visitor consent/reference unavailable. Remove cached personal data.

Error429.description: Rate limited by a player, project, developer, network, polling or admission budget. Pause the request queue for Retry-After seconds; retry with jitter and a bounded attempt count. See https://developer.webump.app/rate-limits.html.
